responseMessageContents.text:
You're on the Pro plan, which gives you full access to all app building capabilities — code generation, editing, debugging, image generation, and all the tools I use to build your app. 

**Rork Max** adds extras focused on **publishing and distribution**, not building:

- **App Store submissions** — automated builds and submissions to Apple/Google
- **More build minutes** and priority builds
- **Custom domains** and advanced deployment options

For actually designing and coding your app, you're not missing anything on Pro.
